attr.title: PartyBoard
attr.desc: Native AArch64 port of the PartyBoard (Mario Party 4) reconstruction, running on OpenGL ES 2.0 through the firmware's SDL2. No game data included.
attr.inst: Place a supported Mario Party 4 (GMPE01) .rvz, .iso or .gcm in partyboard/assets. Launch PartyBoard.sh from PortMaster.
